run_H2HSweep: run a head-to-head evaluation sweep of two agents and collect pivot table results
create_H2HItem: create an H2HItem dataclass to configure a head-to-head agent comparison with optional overrides
build_exp_tag_H2HItem: build an experiment tag string from an H2HItem using agent names and MD5 hashing
launch_missing_H2HSweep: launch missing seeds for already started head-to-head evaluation jobs using the missing flag
postprocess_H2HSweep: postprocess head-to-head evaluation results data by overriding the postprocess method in a subclass
